_fresh.label_prefix: only actual cloud failure boundary mode
_fresh.label_expression: "only actual cloud failure boundary mode"
_fresh.check_expression: mode == "first" and OS.get_environment("CAMPAIGN_CALLBACK_CASE") == FAILURE_CASE

_fresh.label_prefix: SDK disabled and original cloud unattached
_fresh.label_expression: "SDK disabled and original cloud unattached"
_fresh.check_expression: not steam.available and not cloud.cloud_ready and cloud._owner.is_empty()

_fresh.label_prefix: ordinary fresh profile has no pending campaign writer
_fresh.label_expression: "ordinary fresh profile has no pending campaign writer"
_fresh.check_expression:
campaign.records.is_empty() and campaign.unlocked == 1 and campaign.cloud_owner.is_empty()
		and not campaign.persistence_busy() and not cloud.shared_profile_pending()

_fresh.label_prefix: private stage obstruction path is initially absent
_fresh.label_expression: "private stage obstruction path is initially absent"
_fresh.check_expression: not FileAccess.file_exists(BLOCKER) and not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(BLOCKER)

_fresh.label_prefix: own private obstruction parent created
_fresh.label_expression: "own private obstruction parent created"
_fresh.check_expression: DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(BLOCKER_PARENT)) == OK

_fresh.label_prefix: own real stage-parent file obstruction opened
_fresh.label_expression: "own real stage-parent file obstruction opened"
_fresh.check_expression: file != null

_fresh.label_prefix: closed original obstruction is a regular file
_fresh.label_expression: "closed original obstruction is a regular file"
_fresh.check_expression: not blocker_sha.is_empty() and FileAccess.file_exists(BLOCKER) and not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(BLOCKER)

_fresh.label_prefix: actual payload validator accepts bounded local input
_fresh.label_expression: "actual payload validator accepts bounded local input"
_fresh.check_expression: cloud._validate_payload(payload,LOCAL_OWNER)

_fresh.label_prefix: actual production cloud apply returns false on real storage obstruction
_fresh.label_expression: "actual production cloud apply returns false on real storage obstruction"
_fresh.check_expression: not applied

_fresh.label_prefix: same actual Campaign CFG writer remains pending
_fresh.label_expression: "same actual Campaign CFG writer remains pending"
_fresh.check_expression: writer != null and writer.busy() and campaign.cloud_configuration_pending()

_fresh.label_prefix: real failed writer retains frozen ConfigFile proposal
_fresh.label_expression: "real failed writer retains frozen ConfigFile proposal"
_fresh.check_expression: proposal != null

_fresh.label_prefix: actual frozen cloud scope and staging proposal retained
_fresh.label_expression: "actual frozen cloud scope and staging proposal retained"
_fresh.check_expression:
scope.get("operation") == "cloud" and scope.get("target_owner") == LOCAL_OWNER
		and active.get("stage") == "staging" and proposal_values.get("ok",false)

_fresh.label_prefix: real parent-path failure code retained
_fresh.label_expression: "real parent-path failure code retained"
_fresh.check_expression: campaign.get("_cfg_writer_error").get("code") == "CFG_STAGE_PARENT"

_fresh.label_prefix: failed staged cloud write preserves original Campaign memory and CFG bytes
_fresh.label_expression: "failed staged cloud write preserves original Campaign memory and CFG bytes"
_fresh.check_expression: _campaign_memory(campaign) == memory and _cfg_digest() == cfg_sha

_fresh.label_prefix: failed production apply keeps original cloud flags and shared pending profile
_fresh.label_expression: "failed production apply keeps original cloud flags and shared pending profile"
_fresh.check_expression: _cloud_flags(cloud) == flags and not cloud._applying and cloud.shared_profile_pending()

_fresh.label_prefix: actual configuration ERROR pauses with original failure
_fresh.label_expression: "actual configuration ERROR pauses with original failure"
_fresh.check_expression:
flow.phase == flow.Phase.ERROR and flow.last_result.get("config_pending",false)
		and flow.last_result.get("code") == "CFG_STAGE_PARENT" and paused

_fresh.label_prefix: actual configuration failure overlay retained
_fresh.label_expression: "actual configuration failure overlay retained"
_fresh.check_expression: is_instance_valid(flow._overlay) and flow._overlay.visible

_fresh.label_prefix: actual visible retry control is connected to production retry_config
_fresh.label_expression: "actual visible retry control is connected to production retry_config"
_fresh.check_expression:
retry != null and retry.text == "重试保存设置" and not retry.disabled and retry.is_visible_in_tree()
		and retry.is_connected("pressed",Callable(flow,"retry_config"))

_fresh.label_prefix: original obstruction bytes unchanged before own repair
_fresh.label_expression: "original obstruction bytes unchanged before own repair"
_fresh.check_expression: FileAccess.get_sha256(BLOCKER) == blocker_sha

_fresh.label_prefix: only this probe's closed obstruction file is removed
_fresh.label_expression: "only this probe's closed obstruction file is removed"
_fresh.check_expression: DirAccess.remove_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(BLOCKER)) == OK

_fresh.label_prefix: real stage parent repaired to an empty directory
_fresh.label_expression: "real stage parent repaired to an empty directory"
_fresh.check_expression: DirAccess.make_dir_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(BLOCKER)) == OK

_fresh.label_prefix: filesystem repair does not replace pending writer proposal or publish progress
_fresh.label_expression: "filesystem repair does not replace pending writer proposal or publish progress"
_fresh.check_expression:
campaign.get("_cfg_writer") == writer and writer.get("_frozen_cfg") == proposal
		and writer.get("_active") == active and writer.get("_pending_record") == pending
		and Values.semantics(proposal) == proposal_values and _campaign_memory(campaign) == memory and _cfg_digest() == cfg_sha

_fresh.label_prefix: actual UI retry refuses synthetic owner without real account authority
_fresh.label_expression: "actual UI retry refuses synthetic owner without real account authority"
_fresh.check_expression:
flow.last_result.get("code") == "CLOUD_RETRY_SCOPE_CHANGED" and flow.phase == flow.Phase.ERROR
		and flow.last_result.get("config_pending",false) and paused

_fresh.label_prefix: unauthorized retry retains exact same writer scope and frozen proposal
_fresh.label_expression: "unauthorized retry retains exact same writer scope and frozen proposal"
_fresh.check_expression:
campaign.get("_cfg_writer") == writer and writer.get_instance_id() == writer_id
		and writer.get("_frozen_cfg") == proposal and proposal.get_instance_id() == proposal_id
		and writer.get("_active") == active and writer.get("_pending_record") == pending
		and campaign.get("_cfg_writer_scope") == scope and Values.semantics(proposal) == proposal_values

_fresh.label_prefix: refused retry changes no progress CFG memory cloud flags or SDK state
_fresh.label_expression: "refused retry changes no progress CFG memory cloud flags or SDK state"
_fresh.check_expression:
_campaign_memory(campaign) == memory and _cfg_digest() == cfg_sha and _cloud_flags(cloud) == flags
		and not steam.available and not cloud.cloud_ready and not cloud._applying and cloud.shared_profile_pending()

_fresh.label_prefix: ordinary post-refusal frames preserve same original objects and pending data
_fresh.label_expression: "ordinary post-refusal frames preserve same original objects and pending data"
_fresh.check_expression:
campaign.get_instance_id() == campaign_id and cloud.get_instance_id() == cloud_id
		and campaign.get("_cfg_writer") == writer and writer.busy() and writer.get("_frozen_cfg") == proposal
		and _campaign_memory(campaign) == memory and _cfg_digest() == cfg_sha and _cloud_flags(cloud) == flags

_finish.label_prefix: failure boundary cannot substitute authorized account retry or restart
_finish.label_expression: "failure boundary cannot substitute authorized account retry or restart"
